title: The notice that missed the postcard
body: The map’s road is circled in blue, then crossed out in black. The postcard is addressed but unstamped; on its back, someone wrote ‘tell them the shop is shut.’ The notice beside it has no delivery mark.
rival_reading: A farm road could be closed during a program inspection, and an undelivered postcard could simply have missed the notice; the lack of a mark does not show a failed response.
gloss: A road notice and an unsent warning to a household never meet in the mailbox.

title: The weather column was not the warning
body: The notebook has a field temperature and a note: ‘smell after rain.’ The newspaper is folded to a public notice with the lower half missing. A reader has underlined the comics instead of the headline.
rival_reading: A partial newspaper could hide an emergency notice, while the field note is ordinary observation; neither item alone proves a program malfunction.
gloss: A field observation and a damaged public notice leave the warning and its cause in different papers.
